recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No follow-up is needed for FHIR-15825 unless a future applied or published issue explicitly changes Observation.focus cardinality.
issue_request: FHIR-15825 was a Published/Persuasive OO change request asking to increase Observation.focus from 0..1 to 0..* so clinical genomics observations can focus on multiple variants when expressing relationships such as cis/trans.
initial_application: Historical commit 468774c1b07865f7af97bf1643874d2e37067aaf, with message GF#16809, GF#16064, GF#15825, changed Observation.focus in source/observation/observation-spreadsheet.xml from 0..1 to 0..*. The later source rework preserved that cardinality in source/observation/structuredefinition-Observation.xml.
additional_context: Observation is active in source/fhir.ini. Later FHIR-44709 considered reducing Observation.focus back to 0..1 as an option for focus-role modeling but resolved Resolved - No Change / Not Persuasive, and later applied focus guidance such as FHIR-43357 did not alter the cardinality.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because the current combined-branch source already defines Observation.focus with min 0 and max *.

related_jiras.note: Later OO issue considered changing Observation.focus to 0..1, but resolved No Change and therefore does not supersede FHIR-15825.
Later applied clarification expanded Observation.focus guidance for DeviceMetric use without changing its cardinality.
